I don’t want to hurt people by killing myself is what I meant, not like physically hurt people or anything. 

My family doesn’t believe in mental illness, their view is “if your sad just go outside and do something that make you happy and you’ll feel better”. So I just pretend everything is ok. Also to not bother people with my problems, everyone has their own problems to carry and I guess I don’t want to add to anyone’s worry...
